context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

I want APM Transactions in Coralogix. I see references to cgx.transaction attributes in the docs. Do I need to set those manually in my SDK instrumentation?

checklist.name: states-that-cgx-transaction-cgx-transaction-r
checklist.description: States that cgx.transaction / cgx.transaction.root are populated automatically by CoralogixTransactionSampler and the user does NOT set them manually. FAIL only if the response tells the user to set cgx.transaction by hand.
